name: Symbol Swap
summary: Symbol Swap is a utility EA that allows traders to quickly switch the chart symbol to another instrument without manually navigating the Market Watch. It provides a convenient interface for rapidly cycling through multiple trading symbols on the same chart, preserving chart settings and template configurations during the swap.
summary_zh: Symbol Swap是一个工具型EA，允许交易者快速切换图表品种到另一个交易标的，而无需手动在市场报价中导航。它提供了便捷的界面，可以在同一图表上快速循环切换多个交易品种，并在切换过程中保留图表设置和模板配置。
strategy_analysis: Symbol Swap是一个纯工具型EA，不具备任何交易策略功能，不会自动开仓或平仓。其核心功能是提供品种切换的便捷操作，通过按钮或快捷键实现图表品种的快速更换。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行任何交易操作。出场条件同样不适用，没有任何仓位管理或资金管理逻辑。仓位管理和资金管理完全不存在，因为该EA的设计目标仅限于图表品种切换辅助功能。整体而言，这是一个提高交易效率的辅助工具，专注于改善用户在多品种分析时的工作流程体验。
strategy_analysis_en: Symbol Swap is a pure utility EA that does not possess any trading strategy functionality and will not automatically open or close positions. Its core function is to provide convenient symbol switching operations, enabling quick chart symbol changes through buttons or hotkeys. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not execute any trading operations. Exit conditions are likewise not applicable, with no position management or money management logic whatsoever. Position sizing and money management are completely absent, as the EA's design goal is limited to chart symbol switching assistance. Overall, this is an auxiliary tool designed to improve trading efficiency, focusing on enhancing the user's workflow experience during multi-symbol analysis.

pros: 操作简便，一键切换品种，大幅提升多品种分析效率
保留了图表模板和设置，切换品种后无需重新配置指标和绘图
轻量级设计，不占用过多系统资源，不影响交易平台的整体性能
pros_en: Simple operation with one-click symbol switching, greatly improving multi-symbol analysis efficiency
Preserves chart template and settings, eliminating the need to reconfigure indicators and drawings after switching
Lightweight design that does not consume excessive system resources or impact overall platform performance
cons: 功能单一，仅提供品种切换，缺少更多实用辅助功能如多图表同步
不支持自动排序或按自定义规则筛选品种列表
没有品种切换历史记录或快捷回退到上一个品种的功能
cons_en: Single-purpose functionality, only provides symbol switching, lacking additional utility features like multi-chart synchronization
Does not support automatic sorting or filtering of the symbol list by custom rules
No symbol switching history or quick fallback to the previous symbol functionality
improvements: 增加多图表同步切换功能，同时切换多个图表的品种
添加品种切换历史记录，支持快速回退到上一个品种
增加品种分组和标签功能，方便按类别管理和切换品种
improvements_en: Add multi-chart synchronization feature to switch symbols across multiple charts simultaneously
Add symbol switching history to support quick fallback to the previous symbol
Add symbol grouping and tagging features for category-based management and switching

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，无交易相关风险
品种切换时可能短暂影响手动交易者的判断，需注意当前显示品种
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any trading operations, no trading-related risks
Symbol switching may briefly affect manual traders' judgment; attention needed to the currently displayed symbol

summary_en: Symbol Swap is a utility EA that allows traders to quickly switch the chart symbol to another instrument without manually navigating the Market Watch. It provides a convenient interface for rapidly cycling through multiple trading symbols on the same chart, preserving chart settings and template configurations during the swap.
